title: TransAct to Launch EPIC TT+, Advancing Its Gaming Technology Beyond the Slot Floor | TransAct Technologies
summary: TransAct will debut the EPIC TT+ at G2E 2026, combining faster processing, 300 dpi printing and EPICENTRAL® connectivity to deliver reliable tabletop transactions and expand player-engagement opportunities across the casino floor.
body_markdown:
September 23, 2026


[PDF Version](https://transacttech.gcs-web.com/node/20546/pdf)


**Next-generation tabletop TITO printer will debut at G2E (Global Gaming Expo) with faster performance, proven reliability and new opportunities for player engagement across the casino**


HAMDEN, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 23, 2026-- TransAct Technologies Incorporated (Nasdaq: TACT), a global leader in software-driven technology and printing solutions for high-growth markets, today announced it will launch the **EPIC TT+™** , its next-generation tabletop gaming printer, at the Global Gaming Expo (G2E) in Las Vegas, on September 29, 2026.


Built to keep TITO transactions moving beyond the slot floor, the EPIC TT+ helps casinos reduce disruptions, limit employee intervention and deliver a faster, smoother patron experience. It also extends EPICENTRAL® connectivity to more transaction points, creating additional opportunities to engage players with relevant promotions throughout their visit.


For existing EPIC Edge TT customers, the EPIC TT+ provides a clear path forward on TransAct’s latest EPIC platform. For casino management system providers, gaming technology partners and operators, it delivers a reliable tabletop solution for cashier cages, player clubs, lounges, redemption areas and other locations where embedded printing is not practical—helping standardize operations while extending the value of TransAct technology across the casino.


“The EPIC TT+ expands on the trusted performance of the EPIC Edge TT while bringing our latest EPIC technology to more transaction points across the casino,” said John Dillon, Chief Executive Officer of TransAct. “It helps customers keep critical tabletop transactions moving reliably while creating more opportunities to connect those interactions with EPICENTRAL® and the broader player experience.”


**Faster, Sharper Performance**


TITO vouchers must print clearly and scan reliably to keep transactions—and patrons—moving. Poorly printed barcodes can result in rejected vouchers, slower redemptions and unnecessary employee intervention.


The EPIC TT+ addresses these challenges with a faster processor and 300 dpi print resolution, compared with the 203 dpi resolution published for leading competitive tabletop TITO printers. The higher resolution produces sharp barcodes and clear ticket information, helping vouchers scan reliably across casino environments.


For operators, this translates into fewer transaction disruptions and a faster, smoother patron experience. For casino management system providers and gaming technology partners, the EPIC TT+ provides a proven, high-quality printing platform for a range of tabletop gaming applications.


**Proven Operational Reliability**


The EPIC TT+ brings together the capabilities that customers need to support reliable daily operations in demanding casino environments:


- **Smoother player transactions.** Faster processing and clear, reliably scannable barcodes help reduce delays, rejected vouchers and employee intervention.


- **More uptime during busy periods.** Built in 600-ticket capacity reduces paper changes and operational interruptions.


- **Fewer Jams. More Dependable Transactions.** Each ticket is fully printed, separated by TicketBurst™ and held by a unique TransAct mechanism until it’s ready to present—helping reduce jams, maintenance and incomplete transactions.


- **Simplified operations and support:** A service-friendly design, streamlined firmware management and the shared EPIC platform make printers easier to deploy, standardize and maintain across embedded and tabletop environments.


Together, these capabilities reduce operational friction and support the fast, reliable experience casino patrons expect.


**More Opportunities to Connect with Players**


Casino patrons interact with multiple transaction points throughout a visit—from slot machines to cashier cages, player clubs and redemption areas. The EPIC TT+ helps operators extend reliable TITO transactions and promotional communications across more of those interactions.


Through ServerPort™ and EPICENTRAL®, the EPIC TT+ can become part of a broader real-time player-engagement ecosystem. EPICENTRAL® enables casinos to deliver targeted promotional offers based on player activity. Extending that connectivity to tabletop transaction points gives casino marketing and guest-experience teams more opportunities to:


- Deliver relevant promotions at the moment of interaction.


- Extend promotional value to more locations across the property.


- Encourage continued play and strengthen player loyalty.


- Gain greater insight into promotional redemption and engagement.


This combination of reliable printing and software connectivity helps casinos improve the immediate transaction while creating more meaningful opportunities to engage patrons.


**Advancing a Proven Gaming Platform**


The EPIC TT+ gives existing EPIC Edge TT customers a clear path forward on TransAct’s latest EPIC platform while providing new customers with a modern tabletop TITO solution designed for reliable daily operation.


The printer supports established cashier, player-club, lounge and redemption workflows. It also provides a foundation for evolving applications in select table-game environments, including certain blackjack and poker-style games.


For TransAct, the launch further advances its strategy of combining proven gaming hardware, trusted customer and partner relationships, and EPICENTRAL® software to deliver greater value across the casino, expanding its footprint beyond hardware.


The EPIC TT+ will be offered through TransAct’s casino management system, original equipment manufacturer and gaming technology partners.


You can see EPIC TT+ in action at G2E, Booth #2423, or contact our experts at +1 877-748-4222.


**About TransAct Technologies Incorporated**


TransAct Technologies Incorporated is a global leader in developing and selling software-driven technology and printing solutions for high-growth markets, including foodservice technology and casino and gaming. The company’s solutions are designed from the ground up based on customer requirements and are sold under the BOHA!®, AccuDate™, EPICENTRAL® and EPIC® brands. TransAct has sold millions of printers and terminals around the world and is committed to providing world-class service, spare parts and accessories to support its installed product base. For more information, visit[www.transact-tech.com](https://www.transact-tech.com/) .
